name: codex-fpga-engineering-workflow
description: Local human-assisted adaptation of upstream 0.4.0; see ADAPTATION.json. Evidence-driven multi-agent FPGA and SoC FPGA engineering workflow for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-role FPGA design, verification, timing, and review.
interface.longDescription: A single-writer, evidence-driven Codex workflow for FPGA/SoC FPGA architecture, live project/task contracts, official IP integration, cycle-accurate verification, CDC/RDC, STA, physical QoR, three-vendor toolflows, board planning, and independent sign-off.
defaultPrompt: Run the FPGA workflow for this task and preserve existing project evidence.
Review this FPGA change for CDC, timing, interfaces, and verification gaps.
Plan a minimal, verifiable RTL implementation with independent sign-off.
